text:
max: Heads-up — finance is planning a Starter+Basic SKU consolidation next month. New default rate cap will be 3rps/org for the consolidated Starter. We expect the promo to drive ~2x active orgs in EU-WEST for ~6 weeks. Need a short capacity forecast (GPU hours + prewarm plan) and mitigation options. Any quick wins?

anya: Timing? Is this a soft rollout or full cutover? Need to know window for provisioning.

max: Target cutover 2027-12-08. It's a staged rollout but finance will enable promo flags mid-December. Recommendation: plan for a worst-case 2x concurrent utilization in EU for weeks 1–6, then taper.

chung: Quick back-of-envelope: if avg session = 25 tokens/sec, 1.2k tokens per session, and we serve 3rps * 2x orgs => rough QPS increase. Here's a tiny calc I pasted into the thread:

```
expected_new_orgs = 2 * baseline_active_orgs_eu
sessions_per_org_peak = 0.08 * active_users_per_org  # conservative
peak_rps_per_org = 3  # enforced rate cap
# rough GPU-hour estimate per 1k rps (baseline medium model) = 20 GPUh/day
# scaling: quantized variant could cut this by ~2.5x
```

chung: TL;DR: without quantized fallbacks, EU pool needs +18-24 GPUh/day during peak to keep p95 latency under 600ms. With 4-bit fallback that drops to ~7-10 GPUh/day. Numbers need verification with real traces. :thinking:

olivia: Product note — we can gate the promo by cohort so not every org will flip at once. But marketing wants broad enablement after 1 week. We should propose a canary plan (10%/30%/100%) tied to region.

raj: For infra, here's a rough plan: reserve a 24-GPU burst pool for EU-WEST (24 x A10-ish equivalents) and an autoscale floor for baseline. Prefill the pool and set an autoscaler cooldown of 3m. Prometheus queries to watch: `sum(rate(realtime_tokens_generated[1m])) by (region)` and `avg_over_time(gpu_utilization[5m])`. Also add a short-circuit route to quantized-models when queue depth > 30.

devops-bot: [automated] EU-WEST GPU pool utilization currently 68% (last 5m). No alerts firing.

finance-bot: If the promo drives 2x EU usage, estimate revenue +15% for Q4 but cost/GPUh needs to be modeled against reserved vs on-demand. We prefer reservation for predictable cost.

max: OK — action items: (1) eng-infra to produce a 6-week GPU-hour table for the staged rollout, (2) eng-ml to validate quality degradation for 4-bit fallback on our top 5 prompts, (3) product to confirm canary percentages and final cutover date. Please add expected lead times for procurement if reserve pool looks needed. :rocket:

anya: I'll assemble the forecast and a procurement note. Quick draft I will push Monday. Short summary I'll drop here once refreshed with real metrics.

chung: To help, I'll run a small trace replay on eu-trace-2027-11 and try the 4-bit fallback. If anyone wants the test harness: `./tools/replay --trace eu-trace-2027-11 --scale 2.0 --model rtx-medium-q4`

anya: Draft forecast (conservative) — pasted: 

```
week_1: +12 GPUh/day (canary 10%)
week_2: +20 GPUh/day (30%)
weeks_3-6: +24 GPUh/day (100% promo active)
total_extra_gpu_hours_month: ~720 GPUh
mitigations: 4-bit fallback, reserved 24-GPU burst, staged canary
procurement_lead_time: 10 business days if reserved GPUs needed
```

anya: I'll post a cleaned table Monday AM and tag raj/olivia/finance for signoff.

max: Nicely done. If we get those numbers Monday we can lock a reservation by EOW. Thanks everyone.
